title: Scratch briefing: PRD edits + launch day spine
content:
Quick capture — goal: reduce cognitive friction. Not polished. Use as single source while I triage PRD edits, stakeholder asks, and final launch checklist.

Morning block (8:30–10:30) — digestion + PRD edits
- Read through PRD v0.9 (notes from yesterday's sync). Focus areas: rate-limiting language, rollout windows, telemetry hooks.
- Make explicit rollout policy: canary 10% for 48h, rollback threshold: error rate + latency P95 spike > 2x baseline for 30m. Add to PRD under "Rollouts".
- Update "backward compatibility" section: clarify API changes (header deprecation), add example curl for old client behavior and migration notes.
- TODO: add migration note for SDKs (JS/py) — ask DX to add snippet.
- Quick diffs to apply: change section titles: "Monitoring" -> "Observability & Tracing"; add table of signals to monitor (token cost/req, P95 latency, error rate, fallback rate).

PRD edit summary (what to actually change)
- New subsection: "Fallbacks & Graceful Degradation" (bullet list).
- Add matrix: model variant vs region vs tier (what to fall back to).
- Add operational runbook stub: steps 1–5 for oncall to flip traffic and notify customers.

Stakeholder follow-ups (short notes to send)
- Eng infra (Devon): confirm GPU pool capacity for dedicated day 1; reply by EOD. Link: JIRA-7890.
- DX (Lena): SDK snippet + mention of breaking header; offer pair edit session tomorrow 9am.
- Legal: confirm data retention phrasing (private deployments). Ping with proposed sentence: "Customer data used for inference is not retained beyond request processing unless customer opts in."
- Sales: one-pager for pre-commit customers describing SLA tiers and burst behavior (draft in GH PR #456).

Launch checklist (quick, actionable — not exhaustive)
- [ ] Final PRD merged (owner: me) — target: today
- [ ] Demo script + smoke test list finalized (owner: QA) — target: tomorrow morning
- [ ] Canary deploy plan documented with rollback criteria — done (add link to runbook)
- [ ] Console dashboard widgets for feature flagged route (cost, latency, errors) — request to observability team
- [ ] Customer-facing email template for early adopters (what's new + known limitations) — draft ready
- [ ] Confirm billing/usage tags for experimental routes — finance check-in 7/3

Notes from 11:00 sync with Eng-Serving (raw)
- Concern: KV cache invalidation at scale when we do prefix caching; proposes TTL-based sharding to avoid cascade invalidation. Action: schedule follow-up with infra (Devon) + runtime (Mark) to sketch architecture.
- Kernel selection: want to pin to quantized path for lower-cost tier; need performance benchmark for 2k seq vs 4k seq. Request: bench next 48h.

Risks / open questions (for PM brain dump)
- Risk: first-day traffic spike could hit Dedicated pool and bubble to hosted fallback, causing inconsistent behavior for customers on Dedicated — need explicit communication.
- Q: Do we allow partial failure modes for embeddings in the same request? (e.g., fallback to smaller model only for embeddings) — note to design.
- Q: Pricing page clarity — are we showing per-token for streaming vs non-streaming? If not, update.

Afternoon micro-tasks (13:00–16:00)
- Post PRD changes, create GH PR and request reviews from Lena + Mark.
- Draft short Slack message for #product-updates about the canary window and how SRE will monitor; include oncall rotation.
- Quick run through QA smoke list; identify any missing e2e coverage for fallback paths.

Personal ops (reminders)
- Standup: keep it crisp — 3 blockers only.
- Block 45m after lunch for async reviews.
- If Legal responds with heavy wording, escalate to VP product.

Random scratch bits (notes to self)
- Consider adding "cost guardrail" feature: automatic throttling of non-critical routes when token spend exceeds threshold. Could pair with Optimize recommendations.
- Keep PRD language less prescriptive about internal infra names. Use architecture-agnostic wording.

Sendables (short drafts to paste)
- To Devon: "Can you confirm Dedicated GPU pool target capacity for day-one traffic? I put a conservative estimate in JIRA-7890; if you can confirm by EOD we can lock the commit. Thanks — Ava."
- To Lena: "SDK snippet: show old header + new header migration. Can we pair 9–9:30am tomorrow to add JS + py examples?"

End-of-day goals
- PRD merged, GH PR open, 1 slack update posted, canary plan linked in runbook.

---
Small capture: ideas for retrospective after launch
- Quick heatmap of fallback triggers over first 72 hours.
- Postmortem template with timeline + decisions + followups + cost delta.

(temporary: saved local)
summary: Personal PM scratchpad capturing PRD edits, stakeholder ask list, launch checklist, sync notes, and open questions.
